text:
natalie: Hi @support, hitting a weird rerank bug in prod — results are ordered lexicographically, so higher-scored items end up last. Only happens from our edge workers (Cloudflare).

sam: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the request body you sent (sans PII)? also sdk version + env? :eyes:

natalie: using @redwood-ts-sdk v0.12.3, running in Cloudflare Workers. here's sanitized body we log right before fetch:

```json
{
  "query": "find best answer",
  "candidates": ["a", "b"],
  "scores": ["0.9", "0.12"]
}
```

sam: ah — scores are strings. server expects numbers (floats). can you repro the same request from Node (not edge)?

natalie: from our dev machine (node) it sends numbers and rerank is fine. only edge shows strings. we traced it to the fetch polyfill we use that JSON.stringifys things twice?

lee: thanks, this rings a bell. some edge runtimes stringify the payload earlier and the TS SDK's encode step treats already-stringified bodies as raw string and doesn't coerce numeric arrays. can you share the SDK call?

natalie: we call: 

```ts
await client.rerank({
  query: 'find best answer',
  candidates: ['a','b'],
  scores: [0.9, 0.12],
})
```

sam: and the network trace from the edge showed the outgoing content-type is application/json and body is the JSON blob with scores as strings?

natalie: yep, here's the outgoing raw request we captured (headers removed):

```
{"query":"find best answer","candidates":["a","b"],"scores":["0.9","0.12"]}
```

lee: OK. repro steps for us to debug: 1) Cloudflare Worker runtime 2) use node-fetch/fetch polyfill that pre-stringifies 3) call v0.12.3 TS SDK rerank 4) observe body contains quoted numbers.

marco: quick theory: when SDK detects Request/Body is a string it bypasses internal serializer and assumes payload already serialized — but it doesn't validate element types when arrays are provided as strings. On server side, parser allows strings -> numbers but downstream ranking code sorts lexicographically because scores remained strings.

sam: temporary workaround for customers: map(Number) before calling rerank: 

```ts
await client.rerank({
  ...payload,
  scores: payload.scores.map(Number),
})
```

natalie: that fixes it for us, thanks. any ETA on an official fix?

lee: we'll patch the SDK to normalize numeric arrays to numbers before sending (edge-safe). I'll open an internal issue and cut 0.12.4 today. also add a runtime check + unit test for cloudfetch edge case.

sam: recording incident for support queue, tagging as P2 due to customer impact (ordering wrong could be critical).

deploy-bot: new deploy rolled: canary -> us-west, id: dpl-7821 :rocket:

lee: tracked in PR #482, will include: input normalization (scores), better logging when body contains stringified JSON, and doc note about edge fetch polyfills.

natalie: appreciate quick turnaround. we'll keep the workaround in place until we upgrade. :thumbsup:

sam: closing loop — if you can share a small repro repo we can run CI against Cloudflare Worker to validate the cut build before you upgrade.

natalie: will do, sending link in a follow-up DM.

lee: patch published to npm as 0.12.4-rc1, please try once available and we will promote to stable after customer verification.

sam: thanks everyone, marking resolved for now but leaving the thread open for follow-ups.
